# secureaccess_tenant_control (Data Source)

This data source reads a Tenant Control, found by its `id` or by its `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_tenant_control" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Tenant Control.

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Tenant Control.
- `is_legacy` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is a legacy Tenant Control.
